name: com.iampass.iampass.ui.IPBiometricsActivity
description: The IAMPASS authentication SDK opens the Android system authentication prompt when a challenge requires device biometrics or the device credential. It returns success, failure, cancellation, or unsupported status to the sign-in flow.
disableEffect: IAMPASS challenges that require the system biometric or device-authentication prompt will fail or be cancelled.
